purpose: Machine-readable boundary between the supported RingRift AI/training surface and historical, diagnostic, or experimental tooling. This keeps outside review focused on code paths that are current and defended by tests.

supported_ai_surfaces.role: Canonical Python phase/move contracts and history validators.
Python replay mirror of the TypeScript rules engine.
Supported encoding, checkpoint-contract, model-versioning, and training modules.
Canonical self-play generator with parity and history gates.
Canonical phase-history validator for replay databases.
Preferred replay database to NPZ export path.
Policy self-play JSONL to NPZ converter used by the minimal loop.

experimental_or_diagnostic_surfaces.role: Active experiments and prototypes. Not public proof-path code unless promoted into the supported surface.
Investigation notes, hypotheses, and future plans.

historical_surfaces.role: Deprecated AI implementations and compatibility references.
Archived scripts retained for incident history or reference.

promotion_rule: A script or AI module becomes supported only after it is listed here, linked from a current runbook or reviewer doc, covered by a focused test or gate, and clear about canonical-vs-legacy data assumptions.
publication_rule: Do not cite experimental or historical surfaces as public evidence unless the claim is explicitly marked experimental and its artifacts are mirrored in docs/data/results_evidence_manifest.json.
